pr_body:
Previously, show backup was admin only. This change makes it in line
with BACKUP which determines the need for an admin or not based on the
URI and creds.

Fixes: #57294

Release note (sql change): Show backup is no longer admin only. It
depends on the URI construct and the creds specified in the SHOW BACKUP
query.
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/57412)

issue_context.title: bulkio: allow SHOW BACKUP for non-admin users
issue_context.body:
It looks like `SHOW BACKUP` requires admin privileges even to show backups executed by a non-admin. See example:

```bash
fabio@:26257/defaultdb> show databases;
  database_name | owner
----------------+--------
  fabio         | fabio


fabio@:26257/defaultdb> backup database fabio TO 's3://fabiog1901qq/fabio?AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=xxxyyyzzz&AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=xxxyyyzzz&AUTH=specified';
        job_id       |  status   | fraction_completed | rows | index_entries | bytes
---------------------+-----------+--------------------+------+---------------+--------
  611984268939100161 | succeeded |                  1 |    2 |             0 |    24


fabio@:26257/defaultdb> show backup 's3://fabio/fabio?AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=xxxyyyzzz&AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=xxxyyyzzz&AUTH=specified';
ERROR: only users with the admin role are allowed to SHOW BACKUP
SQLSTATE: 42501


-- path works with admin
root@:26257/defaultdb> show backup 's3://fabio/fabio?AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=xxxyyyzzz&AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=xxxyyyzzz&AUTH=specified';
  database_name | parent_schema_name | object_name | object_type | start_time |             end_time             | size_bytes | rows | is_full_cluster
----------------+--------------------+-------------+-------------+------------+----------------------------------+------------+------+------------------
  NULL          | NULL               | fabio       | database    | NULL       | 2020-12-01 14:32:56.879062+00:00 |       NULL | NULL |      false
  fabio         | public             | fabio       | table       | NULL       | 2020-12-01 14:32:56.879062+00:00 |         24 |    2 |      false
```

review_comments: nit: I'd invert this and only check if isAdmin if we care, i.e. if the URI says we need to.
